name: Decimal expansion of Vardi constant arising in the Sylvester sequence.
comment: Vardi showed A000058(n) = floor(c^(2^(n+1))+1/2) where c=1.26408473...
Named after the Canadian mathematician Ilan Vardi (b. 1957). - _Amiram Eldar_, Jun 22 2021
This constant is transcendental. - _Quanyu Tang_, Mar 20 2025
